jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Candid Health is growing our Product Management team, we're looking for an experienced PM to partner closely with our engineering organization and external customers. We're delivering transformative software to healthcare providers, turning complex payments ecosystems into a human-centered platform that empowers providers to better serve their patients. You will become deeply embedded within the company and shape the vision of large swaths of the product surface area.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - You’ll be improving our existing product management practices building out new systems that will enable Candid to deliver great products and services

 - You’ll be building and executing the product vision in close collaboration with Engineering and Design 

 - You’ll be thinking about the macro-structure of the business and the product to identify gaps and generate new ideas

 - You’ll be held accountable for business goals, and ensuring your partner teams are as well

 - You’ll be creating rigorous reporting dashboards for visibility and accountability

 - You’ll be capturing signal from the field and our customers to understand and prioritize user needs

 - You’ll be responsible for communication about new feature customer rollouts to customers and internal stakeholders including company leadership and operations teams




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 4+ years of experience as a product manager

 - You have experience building data-intensive products and applications 

 - You ground your thinking in unit economics of the business

 - You are data driven and can leverage it to provide insights and influence critical decisions

 - You are low ego and high output

 - You are outcome oriented, are an effective collaborator, and you bias towards action

 - You may have led and scaled a successful product team or have been part of a fast growing engineering culture

 - You may have experience working with healthcare or medical billing, or on the technical side of other highly regulated industries




PAY TRANSPARENCY

The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $160,000 to $205,000 USD; commensurate with experience. The listed range is a guideline from Pave https://www.pave.com/ data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.



Please note: we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, New York, or San Francisco). Our weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Implementation
jobs.description:
Candid Health is looking for a Technical Program Manager - Implementation to serve as the connective tissue between our Engineering, Product, and Operations teams. This is a high-impact role designed for someone who thrives on organization and can navigate the complexities of a fast-growing platform.

You will be responsible for taking high-level business objectives and breaking them down into technical milestones, ensuring that our EPD (Engineering, Product, Design) teams are aligned with our Operations and Implementation goals. You’ll be the person who ensures that as our product grows more complex, our ability to deliver it to customers remains seamless.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Program Orchestration: Lead the planning and execution of large-scale initiatives. You will create the roadmaps, define the milestones, and track progress across multiple teams to ensure on-time delivery.

 - Bridge Operations & EPD: Act as the primary point of contact for Operations teams. You will translate customer implementation needs into technical requirements and manage the rollout of new features to stakeholders.

 - Master Cross-Functional Integration: You will map and manage the complex interdependencies between our core infrastructure and customer-facing workflows. By identifying technical and operational bottlenecks early, you ensure that platform updates and large-scale implementations move forward without friction or surprises.

 - Risk Mitigation: Anticipate bottlenecks and technical risks before they become "fires." You’ll facilitate trade-off organic discussions between speed of delivery and technical debt.

 - Visibility & Communication: Provide clear, concise updates to leadership on program health, resource allocation, and core KPIs.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Experienced Program Leader: You have 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or a similar role.

 - Technically Fluent: You don't need to be an engineer, but you are comfortable in technical environments. You understand how APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure work together and can follow technical discussions with ease.

 - Expert Communicator: You excel at taking a complex technical update and distilling it into a clear status report for non-technical stakeholders.

 - Operational Mindset: You have a bias toward action. You enjoy building the "system for the work" so that everyone else can do their jobs effectively.

 - Collaborative & Resilient: You are a natural relationship builder who can influence teams without having direct authority over them. You stay calm under pressure and help teams navigate shifting priorities.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects from inception to launch.

 - Proficiency with project management tools (Jira, Linear, Asana etc.) and documentation software (Confluence, Notion).

 - Experience in a fast-paced SaaS environment is a major plus.

 - Strong analytical skills; you use data to drive decisions and measure project success.


Pay Transparency

Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Candid Health, we’re searching for a Product Marketing Manager to craft the narrative for Candid Health’s product roadmap and articulate the differentiated benefit we bring to our customers as a transformative autonomous revenue cycle automation platform. As a key strategic investment for the company and product, you will be working on highly impactful and visible outcomes. This is an opportunity to get in at the ground floor of designing and building something exciting and new in a customer-centric, scalable, value-driven, and highly collaborative way with other top-tier talent.




WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 - Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to understand Candid Health’s GTM needs. Work with product and commercial leaders to coordinate and lead the development and execution of end-to-end launch plans for new features, products, and technology integrations.

 - Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels to drive product adoption, pipeline generation, and customer engagement. Collaborate with demand gen and content partners to translate product positioning into campaign strategies, manage campaign calendars aligned to product releases and GTM milestones, and track performance metrics to optimize messaging and conversion.

 - Build the product marketing function from the ground up, establishing scalable program elements (such as a tiering system for product feature launches and regular market update cadences) that are tailored to Candid Health’s unique position and organizational maturity.

 - Research and identify industry best practices, market trends, and competitive insights. Design winning positioning frameworks, value propositions, and messaging that establish the winning position of Candid Health’s platform and drive strategic direction for segment growth.

 - Build high-quality deliverables including pitch decks, battlecards, demo videos, 1-pagers, and proposal templates to enable our commercial teams. Develop customer lifecycle initiatives—such as customer advocacy, references, and community—and turn customer success into tangible case studies and testimonials that drive pipeline and solution adoption.







WHO YOU ARE

 - You have a Bachelor’s degree as a minimum requirement in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

 - You have 3 to 6 years of experience working within dedicated Product Marketing (PMM) roles, specifically in the Enterprise B2B space.

 - You’ve built and maintained successful, end-to-end go-to-market strategies and launch plans for enterprise SaaS products.

 - You have well-developed opinions on value-based messaging, extractable use-case narratives from technical specifications, and competitive positioning strategies.

 - You have excellent cross-functional influence and a builder's mindset; you know the right frameworks and processes to build a functional, durable, and scalable product marketing arm.

 - You’re a clear and concise communicator; you enjoy the challenge of explaining complicated, technical ideas in simple, value-driven terms, both in-person and in writing.




PAY TRANSPARENCY

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
The Role

At Candid Health, we’re searching for a Platform Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive operational strategy alongside engineering and product leadership. As a dedicated partner embedded within our Platform Engineering team, you will own the team's long-term roadmap and operational cadence rather than bouncing between short-term projects. Your mission is to translate complex, multi-team dependencies into clear execution plans—maximizing engineering velocity and ensuring our infrastructure scales as fast as our business.

This is an opportunity to get in at the ground floor of designing a world-class operational engine alongside top-tier talent in a highly collaborative, data-informed environment.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 - Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Platform Engineering, Product Management, and Delivery leaders to translate long-term product strategy and technical architecture into actionable, shared roadmaps.

 - Orchestrate Complex Technical Launches: Lead the end-to-end planning and risk management for critical platform initiatives—such as major cloud migrations, framework upgrades, or API changes—ensuring seamless rollouts with zero operational disruption.

 - Bridge Internal Systems & External Interfaces: Bring order to chaos by aligning internal metric tracking (OKRs, KPIs) with external platform touchpoints, smoothly coordinating how we roll out infrastructure changes to both internal teams and external customer IT partners.

 - Standardize Delivery Frameworks: Establish lightweight, highly effective operational processes across the department. Optimize project management tools (e.g., Jira, Linear), eliminate structural bottlenecks, and create clear visibility into project health for stakeholders.

Who You Are (Required Qualifications)

 - An Experienced Program Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional technical programs within a fast-growing B2B SaaS or platform ecosystem-including a sustained stretch (2+ years) as the ongoing, embedded TPM for a single platform or infrastructure team.

 - A Chaos Coordinator: You have a proven track record of managing multi-team technical rollouts—such as system-wide migrations, access management updates, or core developer tool implementations—from concept to completion.

 - Operational Architect: You possess well-developed philosophies on what great execution looks like, knowing how to balance process with speed, and how to measure organizational velocity effectively.

 - Data-Informed Problem Solver: You are highly data-literate and love using numbers to tell a story. You are comfortable writing SQL or leveraging modern AI productivity tools to track metrics, diagnose roadblocks, and automate status tracking.

 - An Exceptional Translator: You are a clear, empathetic communicator who can effortlessly bridge the gap between deeply technical infrastructure concepts and business-facing teams, executives, or client IT departments.
